Custom Built-Ins, Cabinetry & Architectural Carpentry

We build the built-ins, media walls, closets, and cabinetry that make a house feel finished — designed for your space, not pulled off a shelf.

323 Renovations isn’t a general remodeling company.

We specialize in custom carpentry — built-ins, media walls, closets, and cabinetry — built to fit your home’s exact dimensions and how you actually live in it. That focus is why homeowners across Tampa Bay bring us their built-in projects.

Our Mission

Our mission is simple: add value to every homeowner we work with through relationships grounded in trust, honesty, and integrity — kept strong by staying in constant communication, from the first conversation to the final walkthrough.

About Us

Meet Dan & Lisa

323 Renovations is a family business, run by Dan and Lisa and built on the same values we live out at home.

Before founding 323 Renovations, Dan spent 25 years in Florida state law enforcement, serving and protecting the citizens of this state — the same sense of duty and integrity that goes into every project we take on today.

Our Christian faith guides how we treat every customer we work with.

Common questions

How long does a typical built-in take?

It depends on the scope of the project, but most built-ins run about 4–6 weeks from signed estimate to install.

Do you handle the design, or do I need my own plans?

We handle the design. Send us your inspiration — a Pinterest board, a magazine photo, anything you like — and we’ll turn it into an AI-generated render of your space, then build the plan around that render before any work begins.

What materials do you build with?

We build with cabinet-grade plywood and species-specific hardwood for face frames, countertops, and other exposed surfaces. Most projects get a cabinet-grade paint finish, though we're happy to do stain-grade work too. Every drawer and door runs on soft-close Blum hardware.

Is the estimate free?

Yes — consultations and estimates are free with no obligation.

Ready to talk through your project?

Common questions

Can you mount my TV as part of the build?

Yes — we mount the TV, route the cables inside the wall or cabinetry, and build the surrounding storage so nothing is left exposed.

Will this work with my existing sound bar or speakers?

We design the niche or shelf around your actual equipment’s dimensions and ventilation needs, whatever you already own.

What materials do you build with?

We build with cabinet-grade plywood and species-specific hardwood for face frames, countertops, and other exposed surfaces. Most projects get a cabinet-grade paint finish, though we're happy to do stain-grade work too. Every drawer and door runs on soft-close Blum hardware.

Common questions

How do you measure for a custom closet?

We come out and measure the space in person (or work from photos and dimensions you send us) before building a design around your exact footprint.

What materials do you use for closet systems?

Cabinet-grade plywood with a durable paint or laminate finish, plus solid hanging rods and soft-close drawer hardware throughout.

How long does a closet build take?

Most reach-in closets take 2–3 weeks from signed estimate to install; larger walk-in systems can run 4–6 weeks.

Is the estimate free?

Yes — consultations and estimates are free with no obligation.

Common questions

Do you replace cabinets or just reface them?

Both — we’ll walk through your existing boxes and tell you honestly whether refacing makes sense or a full replacement is the better long-term investment.

Can you match my existing cabinetry?

In many cases yes, if the style and wood species are still available. We’ll bring samples during your consultation.

What materials do you build with?

We build with cabinet-grade plywood and species-specific hardwood for face frames, countertops, and other exposed surfaces. Most projects get a cabinet-grade paint finish, though we're happy to do stain-grade work too. Every drawer and door runs on soft-close Blum hardware.
